tools.name: iride_get_quote
tools.description: Prices a trip with the live pricing engine. Returns vehicles that fit and a quote_id valid 30 minutes.

tools.name: iride_create_booking
tools.description: Books from a saved quote and emails the secure payment link. Only gratuity may be reselected; no caller-supplied prices. Confirmed once paid. Before booking, confirm the exact pickup date and time with the customer — never assume one, apply a default, or reuse a time from earlier in the conversation

tools.name: iride_find_booking
tools.description: Finds up to 3 bookings by caller ID, confirmation number, or last name + pickup date. Masked data only.

tools.name: iride_verify_caller
tools.description: Checks two matching factors. Returns a 15-minute token for that booking. 3 failures lock the caller for 1 hour.

tools.name: iride_get_booking
tools.description: Verified booking details (no email, card or payment data).

tools.name: iride_modify_booking
tools.description: Keeps the 4-hour change lock and new-pickup notice (12h transfers, 3h hourly). Unpaid tip-only edits apply; paid/pending-payment tips need staff approval. Other price increases and stops still need approval; never charges/refunds.

tools.name: iride_cancel_booking
tools.description: 24+ hours before pickup: records a cancellation request for admin to refund. Otherwise transfer to dispatch.

tools.name: iride_get_knowledge
tools.description: Fleet, service area, airports, policies, child seats and FAQ.

tools.name: iride_request_callback
tools.description: Creates a dispatch callback task and alerts the team.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: iride_create_booking, iride_get_booking · Private data: iride_verify_caller, iride_cancel_booking · Public sink: iride_get_booking · Destructive: iride_modify_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: iride_create_booking, iride_get_booking · Private data: iride_verify_caller, iride_cancel_booking · Public sink: iride_get_booking · Destructive: iride_modify_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
